title: Starting a new sensor without queueing a "stop sensor" first
symptom: When starting a new sensor, if the xDrip UI is still in 'running' state and the user forgets to stop the sensor before placing the transmitter, the newly placed sensor receives a 'stopped' event and cannot be started anymore.
cause: The xDrip UI still shows 'running' state after an old sensor has been stopped, and if a new sensor is placed without stopping the UI first, the queued 'Stop Sensor' item is sent to the new transmitter, causing the new sensor to be stopped.
fix: A brute force method: wait for the transmitter's connection interval to reset to 0, then wait 10 seconds, stop sensor, and immediately clear the queue. Then restart the phone; for G6, xDrip will auto start its session.
evidence_quote: Wait for it to reset to 0. Then, wait 10 seconds. Now, stop sensor. As soon as you approve stopping sensor, clear the queue. If you do that exactly as I have explained, you will stop the xDrip session without stopping the session on the transmitter.
